term: prior (simply, in time, or in substance)
resolution: When the aporia of Metaphysics XII.6, 1071b22-24, and the Night cosmogony (1071b26-28) say that potency is prior, the case reads 'prior' as simple priority (`PriorSimply`), the sense of the premise STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY. Only on that reading are STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT and STMT-NIGHT-UNPRECEDED-POTENCY-ACTUALIZED rivals of the premise. Aristotle's first answer ('nothing that is will be', 1071b24-26) and his later remark that chaos or night did not exist for an infinite time (1072a7-8) also touch priority in time, and he grants that to think potency prior is 'in a way right' (1072a3-4). On the temporal reading the position is compatible with the premise: Aquinas grants that potency precedes act in time within one changing thing (ST I q.3 a.1 co.), so it is not formalized as a rival. Every statement of the elimination GENERATION-FROM-NIGHT-REFUTED uses the one predicate `PriorSimply`, so no step passes from one sense to the other. Metaphysics IX.8, 1050b6-7, and In Metaph. IX, lect. 9 n. 1 say that incorruptible beings are prior to corruptible ones in substance and perfection. The case reads that as PriorInSubstance (DEF-PRIORITY-IN-SUBSTANCE), not as PriorSimply: ActPriorFromIncorruptibleFacts reaches simple priority from it only through the explicit unattributed hypothesis PriorInSubstanceIsSimpleReading, so no step there passes silently from one sense to the other. Sense fork (docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md): TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks relates the three senses. PrioritySense enumerates simply, inTime and inSubstance; PriorityFrame.PriorIn unfolds them to PriorSimply, PriorInTime (DEF-PRIORITY-IN-TIME, now a frame parameter) and PriorInSubstance. Coverage (STMT-PRIOR-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE) and exclusivity of the route's reading (STMT-PRIOR-SENSE-UNIQUE) are explicit OPEN frontier premises. PRIOR-SENSE-FORK-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR reaches STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY by cases: simple directly, substance through the open bridge STMT-PRIOR-IN-SUBSTANCE-IS-SIMPLE, time refuted under STMT-TEMPORALLY-FIRST-BEING-IN-POTENCY (ACT-NOT-PRIOR-IN-TIME-FROM-TEMPORALLY-FIRST-POTENCY). No strength order among the three senses is provable without a bridge, so none is registered.
